channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Carl Jung — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-22
item.description: “The healthy man does not torture others. Generally it is the tortured who turn into torturers.” — Carl Jung

item.title: Yi Sun-sin — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-21
item.description: “Those who seek death shall live. Those who seek life shall die.” — Yi Sun-sin

item.title: Cadet Maxim — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-20
item.description: “Risk more than others think is safe. Care more than others think is wise. Dream more than others think is practical.Expect more than others think is possible.” — Cadet Maxim

item.title: Tony Robbins — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-19
item.description: “The meeting of preparation with opportunity generates the offspring we call luck.” — Tony Robbins

item.title: Thomas Edison — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-18
item.description: “Restlessness is discontent — and discontent is the first necessity of progress. Show me a thoroughly satisfied man — and I will show you a failure.” — Thomas Edison

item.title: Ralph Waldo Emerson — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-17
item.description: “Truth, and goodness, and beauty are but different faces of the same all.” — Ralph Waldo Emerson

item.title: Emily Brontë — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-16
item.description: “He's more myself than I am.” — Emily Brontë

item.title: Ralph Ellison — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-15
item.description: “I am invisible, understand, simply because people refuse to see me.” — Ralph Ellison
